electric_guide.text: Welcome to Electric Mountain. Behind me is a whole power station inside Elidir Fawr.
Dinorwig opened in 1984. It is a pumped-storage station: water falls from a high lake to make power, then gets pumped back up.
It can reach full power in about 16 seconds. That is quicker than most kettles, and the whole country uses it.
The cavern is carved into slate. Quarrymen dug the hillside for nearly two centuries, and engineers just kept on digging.

electric_kid.text: It is like a giant rechargeable battery. In a mountain. How cool is that?
I asked if there was a dragon inside. The guide said no. I am not fully convinced.
